name: re-dry-build after extension scope edit
command: cd ~/olympus-nixos || exit 1; fail=0; for c in nyx-nixos aether-nixos ariadne-nixos athena-nixos circe-nixos dionysus-nixos; do echo "=== $c ==="; if nix build ".#nixosConfigurations.$c.config.system.build.toplevel" --dry-run >"/tmp/dry2-$c.log" 2>&1; then echo "EVAL OK: $c"; else echo "EVAL FAIL: $c"; fail=1; tail -40 "/tmp/dry2-$c.log"; fi; done; if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then echo "OVERALL: ALL_OK"; else echo "OVERALL: SOME_FAILED"; fi; exit $fail
